news.title: Buford shooting leaves 23-year-old dead during armed robbery
news.summary: Gwinnett County police detectives are investigating a triple shooting during an armed robbery that left one man dead, and two others wounded in Buford.

news.title: Late night gunfire triggers SWAT response at East Point townhome
